_about: Campaign promises, one object per promise. See contributing/TEMPLATE.md. Only entries with "verified": true appear on the site.

promises.quote: We are going to continue this work, building on the work from the legislation we passed for the roadmap to get back stronger salmon runs in Alaska and stronger fisheries with regard to salmon runs across species, across rivers, across the States, but this bill is a really important part of that, so I will continue to work this.
promises.promise: Said he will keep working to pass the Bycatch Reduction Act.

promises.quote: So I do oppose this effort to change the law, and I will oppose, in the future, other efforts to change the law that Congress already passed.
promises.promise: Said he will oppose future efforts to change the law Congress already passed on the matter at issue.

promises.quote: Mr. President, I rise to follow the comments of my colleague from the Commonwealth of Virginia, and I intend to join him in voting against any proceedings by the United States military, any action by our President to invade or occupy Cuba without authorization by the Senate, by the House, by the Congress of the United States.
promises.promise: Said he intends to vote against U.S. military action to invade or occupy Cuba without congressional authorization.

evidence.description: Voted against the point of order that blocked S.J.Res. 124, a resolution to remove U.S. forces from unauthorized hostilities against Cuba. The point of order was upheld 51–47, ending the resolution.

promises.assessment: The only recorded vote was procedural; he voted on the side of letting the war powers resolution proceed. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: So as the question of how we will conduct ourselves going forward in Cuba, in Ukraine, in the Middle East is before this body, I intend to continue to vote for the Congress to take its constitutional role and, more than anything, for us to not hand away the power of the purse to an overreaching President.
promises.promise: Said he intends to keep voting to assert Congress's constitutional role and power of the purse.

promises.quote:
Glad my bill with @SenTedCruz has passed the Senate and is on to the House.

I will ALWAYS stand up and fight for Alabama’s shrimpers and fishermen.
promises.promise: Said he will always fight for Alabama shrimpers and fishermen.

promises.quote:
ZERO taxpayer dollars should be used to pay for abortions.

Every life is sacred, and I will always fight for the unborn and the taxpayers.
promises.promise: Said he will always oppose taxpayer funding of abortion.

promises.quote:
It is shameful that Democrats refuse to stand up for women and women’s sports.

This is far from over, and I will NEVER stop fighting to permanently restore Title IX protections.
promises.promise: Said he will keep working to permanently restore Title IX protections for women's sports.

promises.quote:
Huntsville was named the top choice for SPACECOM’s permanent home by the first Trump admin AND the Biden admin.

I will keep fighting to bring @US_SpaceCom home to the Rocket City.
promises.promise: Said he will keep working to move U.S. Space Command headquarters to Huntsville.

promises.quote:
Unlike liberal activists judges, President Trump was elected to secure our border and deport those who shouldn’t be here. 

Next week I will introduce legislation to end birthright citizenship for illegal immigrants once and for all.
promises.promise: Said he would introduce legislation the following week to end birthright citizenship for children of illegal immigrants.

promises.quote: President Trump is right. Criminals have terrorized DC for too long. Next month, I will introduce a bill requiring teenagers be charged in criminal court. It’s time for all criminals to face consequences for their actions.
promises.promise: Said he would introduce a bill the next month requiring teenagers to be charged in criminal court.

promises.quote:
With permanent Daylight Savings Time, for three months out of the year, kids in West Arkansas towns like Bentonville, Fayetteville, and Fort Smith would start school in the dark.

I will always oppose any effort to adopt Daylight Savings Time year-round.
promises.promise: Said he will always oppose adopting year-round Daylight Saving Time.

promises.quote: We should be making it easier for Americans to vote, not harder. If the SAVE Act ever comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the SAVE Act if it reaches the Senate floor.

evidence.description: Voted no on cloture for a photo ID requirement offered during Senate debate on the SAVE America Act. Cloture failed 53–47.
Voted no on a motion to add proof-of-citizenship voter registration and photo ID requirements to S. 2. It failed 50–49.

promises.assessment: No up-or-down Senate vote on the SAVE Act itself has happened yet. He voted no on related proof-of-citizenship and photo-ID votes in 2026. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote:
Donald Trump knows the Senate can’t pass a bill to fund the government without 7 Democratic votes. So why is he refusing to negotiate?

I will not be one of those 7 unless we address skyrocketing costs caused by health care cuts and tariffs.
promises.promise: Said he will not vote for a government funding bill unless it addresses health care costs and tariffs.

evidence.description: Voted no on passage of H.R. 5371, the continuing resolution that ended the fall 2025 shutdown. It passed 60–40 with some Democratic votes.

promises.assessment: Said he wouldn't be one of the Democratic votes needed to fund the government without action on health care costs and tariffs; voted no on the deal that ended the shutdown. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I will keep standing up for the men and women of law enforcement, every law enforcement officer, because we know that they are essential not only for a stronger and safer Florida but for a stronger and safer United States of America.
promises.promise: Said she will keep supporting law enforcement officers.

promises.quote: I will keep working to safeguard SBIR-funded technologies from our adversaries and ensure we invest in the best and brightest small businesses so America maintains our technological advantage; however, continuing the status quo is not a solution I can support.
promises.promise: Said she will keep working to protect SBIR-funded technology from foreign adversaries and would not support extending the programs without reforms.

promises.quote: It is for these reasons that every Democrat on the Senate Armed Services Committee voted against advancing [Mr. Hegseth's] nomination, and I will oppose [Mr. Hegseth] on the floor.
promises.promise: Said he will vote against Pete Hegseth's nomination for Secretary of Defense on the Senate floor.

evidence.description: Voted no on Pete Hegseth's confirmation as Secretary of Defense (PN 117). He was confirmed.

promises.notes: Words in [brackets] added for context: 'his'/'him' replaced with Mr. (Pete) Hegseth, named in the preceding sentences of the same speech.
promises.assessment: Promised to oppose the nomination on the floor and voted no. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote:
If any organization or nonprofit is aiding or supporting thugs attacking law enforcement officers, I will make it my personal mission to ensure the organization and its leaders are held accountable.

Not a threat. A promise.
promises.promise: Said she would seek to hold accountable any organization or nonprofit found to be aiding people who attack law enforcement officers.

promises.quote: Florida is home to 21 military installations and three combatant commands—it is imperative we keep our bases secure. That is why I will be fighting for the inclusion of my Drone Espionage Act in the NDAA.
promises.promise: Said she would seek inclusion of her Drone Espionage Act in the NDAA.

promises.quote: As Florida’s next U.S. Senator, I will work tirelessly to reduce the bloat of Washington and speak out loudly against government spending.
promises.promise: Said she would work to reduce the size of the federal government and speak against government spending.

promises.quote: From this key position, I will strengthen U.S. national security and fight for Georgia’s veterans, servicemembers, and their families.
promises.promise: Said that as ranking member of the Military Construction and Veterans Affairs appropriations subcommittee he would work on national security and veterans' issues.

promises.quote:
The SBIR program needs to be reformed to ensure cutting-edge innovation from small businesses gets into the hands of warfighters.

As @SmallBizCmteGOP chair, I will make this happen.
promises.promise: Said that as Small Business Committee chair she would reform the SBIR program to get small-business innovation to the military.

promises.quote: Last week, Democrats voted against the Stop Insider Trading Act. This bill is vital to restore public confidence in Congress and keep our legislative process clean. I will continue to work to get this passed.
promises.promise: Said he will continue working to pass the Stop Insider Trading Act.

promises.quote: I am an original cosponsor of the SAVE Act and proud to safeguard every Idahoan’s vote. We must keep American elections in American hands. I will continue to push for a vote on this important bill with @SenRickScott.
promises.promise: Said he will continue pressing for a Senate vote on the SAVE Act.

promises.quote: I will not vote to fund the illegal DHS and ICE operations that terrorize Chicago, Minneapolis, and many other communities.
promises.promise: Said he will not vote to fund DHS and ICE operations he described as illegal.

evidence.description: Voted no on advancing H.R. 7147, the FY2026 Homeland Security funding bill, including ICE funding. The motion failed.
Voted no again on advancing H.R. 7147. The motion failed.
Voted no on S. 2, a reconciliation bill providing $70 billion for DHS, CBP and ICE immigration enforcement. It passed.

promises.assessment: Voted against every recorded Senate vote on DHS/ICE funding after making the pledge. He voted yes on the Jan. 30 package only after the DHS bill had been split off it. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I’ll always fight to protect hardworking Americans, support good-paying jobs, and ensure resources are available to train our next generation.
promises.promise: Said she will continue to support workers, jobs and job-training resources.

promises.quote: I will never stop fighting to keep Florida the freest state in the nation – a place built on economic freedom and safety in our communities.
promises.promise: Said she will continue working to keep Florida, in her words, the freest state in the nation.

promises.quote: I’ll keep fighting to cut the red tape and outdated regulations standing between our growers and their success.
promises.promise: Said she will keep working to reduce regulations affecting Florida farmers.

promises.quote: I am committed to fighting for policies that cut burdensome regulations, lower costs, and make homeownership achievable for every Florida family.
promises.promise: Said she is committed to policies to reduce regulations and costs for home buyers.

promises.quote: As your U.S. Senator, I will continue to prioritize policies that promote economic prosperity, cut taxes, and slash nonsensical government regulations.
promises.promise: Said she will continue prioritizing tax cuts and reduced regulation.

promises.quote: I will always have their backs as we work together to secure the border, end the fentanyl crisis, strengthen our national security, and protect Florida families.
promises.promise: Said she will support law enforcement on border security and fentanyl.

promises.quote: While some may masquerade as advocates for hemp farmers, even sometimes threatening to hold up government funding over this issue, I will continue to work on behalf of Kentucky's farmers while protecting our children not only in my State but in yours as well.
promises.promise: Continue working on behalf of Kentucky farmers while restricting intoxicating hemp products

promises.quote: Only American citizens should vote in American elections. This is basic common sense. I will proudly cosponsor the SAVE Act, which requires proof of citizenship to register and protects the integrity of our elections.
promises.promise: Said he will cosponsor the SAVE Act requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote.

promises.quote: I will not stop working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented and state and local public servants get the Social Security benefits they deserve.
promises.promise: Said he will keep working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented.

promises.quote: I commit as chairman of the Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee that I will work to pass community health center legislation.
promises.promise: Work as HELP Committee chairman to pass community health center legislation

promises.quote: I will not support any funding deal that puts money in the hands of Stephen Miller, Kristi Noem, and this violent agency.
promises.promise: Said he will not support any funding deal that funds ICE under its current leadership.

evidence.description: Voted no on advancing H.R. 7147, the FY2026 Homeland Security funding bill. The motion failed.
Voted no again on advancing H.R. 7147. The motion failed.
Voted no on S. 2, a reconciliation bill providing $70 billion for DHS, CBP and ICE immigration enforcement. It passed.

promises.assessment: Voted against every recorded Senate vote on DHS/ICE funding after making the pledge. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I will continue to hold this administration accountable and fight to maintain the merit-based nature of these [SBIR and STTR] programs.
promises.promise: Continue fighting to keep SBIR and STTR awards merit-based
promises.notes: Words in [brackets] added for context: 'these programs' bracketed; the same speech names the SBIR and STTR programs.

promises.quote: If the SAVE Act comes to the Senate floor, I will vote NO. I oppose any efforts that jeopardize Americans’ fundamental right to vote.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no if the SAVE Act comes to the Senate floor.

evidence.description: Voted no on cloture for a photo ID requirement offered during Senate debate on the SAVE America Act. Cloture failed 53–47.
Voted no on a motion to add proof-of-citizenship voter registration and photo ID requirements to S. 2. It failed 50–49.

promises.assessment: No up-or-down Senate vote on the SAVE Act itself has happened yet. He voted no on related proof-of-citizenship and photo-ID votes in 2026. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote:
Americans pay into Social Security their entire lives. They deserve their benefits, full stop.

I will fight any and all attempts by President Trump and his Administration to cut Social Security.
promises.promise: Said he will oppose any Trump administration attempt to cut Social Security.

promises.quote: That is why I will be voting no on [the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026] unless--unless--DHS funding is stripped out or unless critical reforms are incorporated into the bill.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 unless DHS funding is stripped or reforms added.

evidence.description: Voted no on advancing H.R. 7148, the funding package that still included the DHS bill. The motion failed 45–55.
The Senate removed the Homeland Security bill from the package.
Voted yes on the amended package without the DHS bill. It passed 71–29.

promises.notes: Words in [brackets] added for context: Replaced 'the bill before us' with [the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026] from the speech heading on the same Congressional Record page.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no unless DHS funding was stripped out; voted no while it was included and yes once it was removed. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I will be voting no on the DHS funding bill because it lacks necessary reforms to immigration enforcement.
promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the DHS funding bill lacking immigration-enforcement reforms.

evidence.description: Voted no on advancing H.R. 7147, the FY2026 Homeland Security funding bill. The motion failed.
Voted no again on advancing H.R. 7147. The motion failed.

promises.assessment: Voted no on every recorded vote on the DHS funding bill after making the pledge. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I will not support this bill that completely fails to help Americans afford their health care.
promises.promise: Said she will not support a bill that fails to help Americans afford health care.

promises.quote: I cannot be bullied to vote for a bill that I know will price more people out of health insurance — especially at a time when everything else is completely unaffordable.
promises.promise: Said she will not be bullied into voting for a bill that prices people out of health insurance.

promises.quote: My power is my vote as a Senator, and I’m not voting to send an extra dollar in funding to ICE/DHS while they trample on Minnesotans like this.
promises.promise: Said she will not vote to send additional funding to ICE/DHS amid enforcement actions in Minnesota.

promises.quote: I am running for another term because that work is not finished. We need a new Farm Bill, better rural housing, and more shipbuilding in our state.
promises.promise: Said she is seeking another term to finish work including a new Farm Bill, better rural housing, and more shipbuilding in Mississippi.

promises.quote: We advanced Chris Wright’s nomination as Secretary of Energy in committee this morning, and I was proud to vote in support. I will continue to support him as he moves through the confirmation process.
promises.promise: Said she will continue to support Chris Wright's Energy Secretary nomination through confirmation.

evidence.description: Voted yes on cloture for Chris Wright's nomination as Secretary of Energy.
Did not vote on the final confirmation, which passed.

promises.assessment: Voted to advance the nomination but missed the final confirmation vote. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: I always have and always will be against the sale of public lands. @TimSheehyMT & I worked together to block this provision from being included in the Senate reconciliation bill and I will always fight for our MT outdoor way of life.
promises.promise: Said he will continue to oppose the sale of federal public lands.

promises.quote: I will fight to get [the Unborn Child Support Act] across the finish line.
promises.promise: Said he will fight to pass the Unborn Child Support Act.
promises.notes: Words in [brackets] added for context: Replaced 'this bill' with [the Unborn Child Support Act] named earlier in the same floor speech on the same page.

promises.quote:
Nope, this story is wrong. I was not talking about the Kaine resolution, which I will be voting against. 

Tariffs must be executed with precision to protect North Carolina farmers and businesses who have been hurt by bad trade policies before, including NAFTA.
promises.promise: Said he will vote against the Kaine resolution on tariffs.

evidence.description: Voted no on S.J.Res. 37, Sen. Kaine's resolution to end the national emergency used for tariffs on Canada. It passed 51–48.

promises.assessment: Said he'd vote against the Kaine resolution and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

promises.quote: The Senate version of the One Big Beautiful bill contains significant changes to Medicaid that would be devastating to North Carolina, and I cannot support it.
promises.promise: Said he cannot support the Senate version of the One Big Beautiful bill because of Medicaid changes.
